x-note: The authority service of 05 section 10 as a compose service (BE-007). JSON is valid YAML, so `podman compose -f services/authority-service/compose.json up --build` reads this file. Like infra/containers/compose.json it uses host networking and binds 127.0.0.1 only: on the WSL Podman machine a socket bound to loopback in the VM is relayed to Windows' loopback, and published ports are not. Put DOCEDIT_AUTHORITY_HOST=0.0.0.0 and a published port in an override for any other network. The service keeps no data, so there is no volume. The caller's storage, for rebuilding a state this replica does not hold, is DOCEDIT_AUTHORITY_STORAGE_URL (src/storage.ts). Tokens come from the environment, which a secret store fills; they are never written here. There is no Helm entry yet: the chart of BE-006 does not exist.
